title: Quasi-coherent derived projection mate with fixed adjunction and tensor comparison
statement: Let X and Y be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and their canonical tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let f:X\to Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let F=Lf^* [def-pc-derived-pullback] and R=Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let p:F\dashv R be an adjunction with counit \epsilon. Let t:F(-\otimes^L-)\simeq F(-)\otimes^L F(-) be a natural isomorphism of bifunctors. For M\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) and L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X), the transpose under p of t_{M,R(L)} followed by 1_{F(M)}\otimes\epsilon_L is an isomorphism M\otimes^L R(L)\to R(F(M)\otimes^L L).

source.place: Tag 08EU, lemma-cohomology-base-change; fourth Hom equality of duality.tex Tag 0A9Q, lemma-iso-on-RSheafHom

proof.text: Apply affine descent for the supplied mate. It suffices to prove the result for Z mapping to Spec A in standard localization universe u+1.

Choose the standard module derived localization. Use the affine quasi-coherent equivalence e, with its triangulated ambient realization and its identification of shifted A with the shifted structure sheaf. Define the all-shifts, isomorphism-invariant locus P on D(A). Its coproduct, triangle and retract closure are supplied by the affine locus theorem.

For every shifted free generator ULift A[m] and every additional shift n, use ULift.moduleEquiv and shiftFunctorAdd to identify the double shift with A[m+n]. Map this isomorphism under e and the ambient inclusion, then use the affine equivalence unit identification and the supplied object isomorphism in P. The shifted-unit mate theorem proves membership in P.

Apply derivedModuleFreeGeneration to e.inverse(M), with the proved generator condition and the three closure conditions. Evaluate its resulting P membership at M and shift zero. The required ambient object isomorphism is e applied to shiftFunctorZero followed by the equivalence counit, mapped under the inclusion.

proof_origin.note: F1: compiling affine-generation reduction. Three strictly intermediate obligations remain: affine descent, shifted-unit components, and closure of the all-shifts locus. ULift/shift/equivalence transport and the free-generation application are proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem qcqsDerivedProjectionMate_isIso (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅
      (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) :
    IsIso (p.homEquiv (M.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj)
      ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj ⊗ L.obj)
        (t.hom.app (M.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj) ≫
          (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj) ⊗ₘ p.counit.app L.obj)))
